stem: A technician believes a different nutrient ratio would perform better than the approved recipe. What may the technician do?
choices: Document the concern and route it through the approved change/escalation process while executing only the authorized recipe.
Change the ratio for one batch as an experiment.
Quietly reduce one ingredient and compare yield later.
Edit the recipe file in place before mixing.
rationale: Document the concern and route it through the approved change/escalation process while executing only the authorized recipe.
